requestSchema.description: Input parameters for the generation task

prompt.description: A text description specifying the desired content or style of the generated image. (Max length: 390000 characters)

image_urls.description: An array containing up to 1 URL string pointing to reference images. (Use file URLs after upload, not raw file content. Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp. Max size: 10.0MB per image.) In your prompt, reference the uploaded image by typing @image(n) followed by a space (for example: @image1 a sunset over the ocean).
